standard_prerequisites.name: A complex with cohomology sheaves supported on the closed subset Z is fixed by the functor i_* R H_Z, by the cohomology complexes-with-support lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the alternating complex with its own local cohomology once supported on Z.

standard_prerequisites.name: The localization maps of the Cech complex are affine, so their direct images agree with derived direct images on quasi-coherent modules, by the relative affine vanishing lemma
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: invoked at proof lines 1209-1211 of the affine identification
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows each term F_{i_0...i_p} is the derived pushforward of its restriction.

standard_prerequisites.name: Local cohomology with support in Z vanishes on modules supported in the open complement of Z, by the sections-support lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Kills the higher Cech terms under R H_Z.

core_obligations: Restate the goal: the map F^bullet -> i_* R H_Z(F) of the cited remark must be an isomorphism; since F^bullet lies in D_Z(O_X), the complexes-with-support lemma gives i_* R H_Z(F^bullet) = F^bullet (proof lines 1194-1202).

Compute the terms: each localization U_{i_0...i_p} -> X is affine (given by inverting the product of the f_i over affine opens), so F_{i_0...i_p} = R(U_{i_0...i_p} -> X)_* F|_{U_{i_0...i_p}} by the relative affine vanishing lemma and quasi-coherence of F (proof lines 1203-1213).

Vanishing and assembly: the pushed-forward term is supported away from Z in the relevant sense, so R H_Z of it vanishes by the sections-support lemma; hence i_* R H_Z(F^p) = 0 for p > 0, and putting everything together F^bullet = i_* R H_Z(F^bullet) = i_* R H_Z(F) (proof lines 1214-1221).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the canonicity of the map and fix F^bullet by the support lemma (proof lines 1194-1202).
Identify the Cech terms as derived pushforwards over affine localization maps (proof lines 1203-1213).
Kill the positive Cech terms under R H_Z and conclude the representation (proof lines 1214-1221).
